text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is a German politician.
MemberOfParliament(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PrussianStateParliament(y) ::: y is the Prussian State Parliament.
NaziReichstag(y) ::: y is the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt :: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
MemberOfParliament(HeinrichSchmidt, PrussianStateParliament) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
MemberOfParliament(HeinrichSchmidt, NaziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a member of the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
∃x (German(x) ∧ MemberOfParliament(x, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ MemberOfParliament(x, NaziReichstag)) ::: Some German politician was part of both the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
